newsitem.title: GERMANY: German 9-mth gross TV ad revs up 13.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: German 9-mth gross TV ad revs up 13.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Gross advertising revenues for the German television industry rose 13.6 percent to 7.52 billion marks in the first nine months of 1996 from the same period a year earlier, the IPA Plus agency said on Monday.
The agency, publishing data provided by Dun and Bradstreet's Nielsen research unit, gave the following details in its latest report on advertising revenue from January to September.
(All figures in millions of marks unless stated.)
